from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def dominant(line):
        color, count = Counter(line).most_common(1)[0]
        return color, count / len(line)

    row_info = [dominant(grid[r]) for r in range(h)]
    col_info = [dominant([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]

    # Lattice lines are the less frequent dominant color among strongly
    # uniform rows/columns; the other color is the repeating cell background.
    row_candidates = [x[0] for x in row_info if x[1] >= 0.70]
    col_candidates = [x[0] for x in col_info if x[1] >= 0.70]
    line_color = Counter(row_candidates + col_candidates).most_common()[-1][0]

    rows = [r for r, (color, frac) in enumerate(row_info)
            if color == line_color and frac >= 0.70]
    cols = [c for c, (color, frac) in enumerate(col_info)
            if color == line_color and frac >= 0.70]

    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return grid

    marked = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols)
              if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return [[line_color]]

    r0, r1 = min(i for i, _ in marked), max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for _, j in marked), max(j for _, j in marked)
    rows = rows[r0:r1 + 1]
    cols = cols[c0:c1 + 1]

    other = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color]
    fill = Counter(other).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            top = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]])
            bottom = (grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            if top[0] == top[1] == bottom[0] == bottom[1] and top[0] != line_color:
                out_row.append(top[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(fill)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out

    def line_sets(axis, threshold=0.60):
        n = len(axis)
        info = []
        for line in axis:
            counts = Counter(line)
            info.append({c: counts[c] / len(line) for c in counts})

        result = {}
        for color in range(10):
            qualifying = [i for i in range(n)
                          if info[i].get(color, 0) >= threshold]
            best = []
            for step in range(2, n + 1):
                for start in qualifying:
                    seq = []
                    i = start
                    while i in qualifying:
                        seq.append(i)
                        i += step
                    if len(seq) > len(best):
                        best = seq
            if len(best) >= 3:
                result[color] = best
        return result

    row_lines = line_sets(grid)
    col_lines = line_sets([[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)])
